calendar_selection: all completed months Jan2021 through Sep2026, fixed without prices/PnL; prior twelve sample days remain spent and included, never called untouched OOS
validation: stream exact single named CSV, 12 columns; ms before2025/us from2025; strict monotonic unique UTC minute opens within month; exact close time; finite positive ordered OHLC, finite nonnegative volumes and integer trade counts, taker volumes <= total; compare every expected minute without filling, trimming, date substitution or duplicate removal
gap_policy: retain true missing intervals and daily counts; any missing/invalid/failed source prevents complete continuous-panel readiness; exclude incomplete panel weeks only from descriptive complete-week count, never trim a prediction cohort because none exists
storage: exact ZIP/CHECKSUM bytes and original request/receipt metadata retained in a separate local raw directory; commit source manifest and quality summaries; resume only checksum-verified bytes bound to exact design/spec; record failures; independent 8-worker transfers, fixed manifest order

power.test: one-sided paired weekly mean-loss improvement, hypothetical normal independent-week approximation
power.interpretation: d is hypothetical mean paired weekly loss divided by weekly SD; no fitted model/loss or measured variance; calendar weeks are not demonstrated independent; blocks are sensitivity units, not proven independence; no minute or cross-symbol multiplication of sample size

execution.scope: public first S3 listing page for eight exact prefixes; retain response/status/hash; empty results or errors establish only observed-prefix access, not global absence; futures never substituted
required_for_historical_readiness: timestamped historical bid/ask and displayed depth at entry/exit
historical impact and partial/rejected fill assumptions
execution.interpretation: fixed planning envelopes, not measured historical costs; no current-book snapshot substitutes for historical execution; no OHLC fill inference and no PnL calculation

decision: report complete or failed continuous coverage, hypothetical power scenarios and execution evidence independently; overall research readiness requires all, otherwise blocked; stop after this study with exact reason; no predictor/trading-cell creation or automatic watch
